question: Does each instrument resolve to one security code, an issuer-role entity, and one synthetic entity identifier? Audit the complete identity path.

question: Audit the current position-to-portfolio-to-manager and position-to-instrument-to-issuer paths; report distinct roles and any incorrect role assignments.
evidence_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.position_id) AS positions,COUNT(DISTINCT issuer.entity_id) AS issuers,COUNT(DISTINCT manager.entity_id) AS managers,SUM(CASE WHEN issuer.entity_role<>'issuer' OR manager.entity_role<>'manager' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS role_errors FROM positions p JOIN opening_positions op USING(opening_id) JOIN accounts a USING(account_id) JOIN portfolios f USING(portfolio_id) JOIN legal_entities manager ON manager.entity_id=f.manager_id JOIN financial_instruments i USING(instrument_id) JOIN legal_entities issuer ON issuer.entity_id=i.issuer_id WHERE p.as_of_date='2027-02-28'

question: For actual buys and sells, select the latest actual USD fixing with as_of_date, published_date and known_date no later than each trade date. Group by currency and side; report trade count, the sum of booked gross_amount (local currency, already rounded per trade to 2dp), and USD total. Translate that booked gross_amount at the eligible rate, then round only the grouped USD sum; do not replace booked amounts with unrounded quantity-price products.
evidence_sql: SELECT t.currency,o.side,COUNT(*) AS trades,COUNT(DISTINCT f.fx_id) AS fixing_records,ROUND(SUM(t.gross_amount),2) AS local_gross,DROUND(DSUM_PRODUCT(t.gross_amount,f.rate),2) AS usd_gross,MAX(CAST(julianday(t.trade_date)-julianday(f.published_date) AS INTEGER)) AS maximum_fixing_age FROM securities_transactions t JOIN trade_orders o USING(order_id) JOIN fx_rates f ON f.from_currency=t.currency AND f.as_of_date=(SELECT MAX(x.as_of_date) FROM fx_rates x WHERE x.from_currency=t.currency AND x.as_of_date<=t.trade_date AND x.published_date<=t.trade_date AND x.known_date<=t.trade_date AND x.view_kind='actual') WHERE t.trade_status='executed' GROUP BY t.currency,o.side ORDER BY t.currency,o.side

question: For each trade-month cohort, currency and actual/planned view, reconcile trade count, signed booked contractual amount (sell +gross_amount, buy -gross_amount) and the remaining sell notional in that same local currency. For the latter accumulate eligible settlement transfers to that month end, then sum open sell quantity times execution quote times multiplier, rounding the local group total to 2dp. Do not translate this report to USD or carry other trade-month cohorts into a group.
evidence_sql: SELECT SUBSTR(t.trade_date,1,7) AS month,t.trade_status,t.currency,COUNT(*) AS trades,ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN o.side='sell' THEN t.gross_amount ELSE -t.gross_amount END),2) AS signed_contractual_amount,ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN o.side='sell' THEN (t.trade_quantity-e.settled_quantity)*t.execution_price*i.price_multiplier ELSE 0 END),2) AS open_sell_receivable_local FROM securities_transactions t JOIN trade_orders o USING(order_id) JOIN financial_instruments i USING(instrument_id) JOIN settlement_instructions si USING(trade_id) JOIN settlement_month_end e USING(instruction_id) GROUP BY month,t.trade_status,t.currency ORDER BY month,t.trade_status,t.currency

evidence_sql: SELECT a.portfolio_id,COUNT(*) AS positions,SUM(CASE WHEN v.valuation_status='complete' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS complete_valuations,ROUND(SUM(v.market_value_base),2) AS partial_usd_value FROM valuation_snapshots v JOIN positions p USING(position_id) JOIN opening_positions o USING(opening_id) JOIN accounts a USING(account_id) WHERE a.portfolio_id='PF-037' AND v.as_of_date='2027-02-28' GROUP BY a.portfolio_id

question: By actual valuation date, reconcile fully accepted versus incomplete portfolio counts and total accepted portfolio value, excluding partial totals.
evidence_sql: SELECT as_of_date,COUNT(*) AS portfolios,SUM(CASE WHEN complete_count=8 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS accepted_portfolios,SUM(CASE WHEN complete_count<8 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS incomplete_portfolios,ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN complete_count=8 THEN value ELSE 0 END),2) AS accepted_usd_value FROM (SELECT v.as_of_date,a.portfolio_id,SUM(CASE WHEN v.valuation_status='complete' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS complete_count,SUM(v.market_value_base) AS value FROM valuation_snapshots v JOIN positions p USING(position_id) JOIN opening_positions op USING(opening_id) JOIN accounts a USING(account_id) WHERE v.view_kind='actual' GROUP BY v.as_of_date,a.portfolio_id) GROUP BY as_of_date ORDER BY as_of_date

question: List each accepted February portfolio and its USD total value, accepting only portfolios whose eight positions all have complete valuation; return the complete portfolio-level list, not just a grand total.
evidence_sql: SELECT a.portfolio_id,ROUND(SUM(v.market_value_base),2) AS accepted_usd_value FROM valuation_snapshots v JOIN positions p USING(position_id) JOIN opening_positions o USING(opening_id) JOIN accounts a USING(account_id) WHERE v.as_of_date='2027-02-28' GROUP BY a.portfolio_id HAVING COUNT(*)=8 AND SUM(CASE WHEN v.valuation_status='complete' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)=8 ORDER BY a.portfolio_id

question: Reconstruct the January sale P&L for OP-001-1 from opening cost plus November and December purchases; compare with its recorded realized P&L.
evidence_sql: SELECT op.opening_id,jan.position_id,op.quantity AS opening_quantity,ROUND(SUM(prior.gross_amount),2) AS prior_buy_cost,SUM(prior.trade_quantity) AS prior_buy_quantity,sale.trade_quantity AS sold_quantity,ROUND(sale.trade_quantity*(sale.execution_price-(op.quantity*op.cost_unit_price+SUM(prior.gross_amount))/(op.quantity+SUM(prior.trade_quantity))),2) AS reconstructed_realized_pnl,jan.realized_pnl FROM opening_positions op JOIN positions jan USING(opening_id) JOIN trade_orders z ON z.account_id=op.account_id AND z.instrument_id=op.instrument_id JOIN securities_transactions prior ON prior.order_id=z.order_id JOIN securities_transactions sale ON sale.trade_id='TR-001-1-3' WHERE op.opening_id='OP-001-1' AND jan.as_of_date='2027-01-31' AND z.side='buy' AND prior.trade_date<sale.trade_date GROUP BY op.opening_id

question: What is the current concentration limit LIM-041-I1?
evidence_sql: SELECT limit_id,entity_id,measure,threshold,effective_from_date,effective_to_date FROM mandate_limits WHERE limit_id='LIM-041-I1'

question: What is the result of LA-LIM-041-I1-4?
evidence_sql: SELECT assessment_id,observed_value,assessment_status,excess_value FROM limit_assessments WHERE assessment_id='LA-LIM-041-I1-4'

question: What is the February denominator for IE-001-1-4?
evidence_sql: SELECT e.exposure_id,e.exposure_amount,e.denominator_amount,e.ratio,e.currency,p.name AS portfolio_name,i.name AS issuer_name FROM issuer_exposures e JOIN portfolios p USING(portfolio_id) JOIN legal_entities i ON i.entity_id=e.issuer_id WHERE e.exposure_id='IE-001-1-4'

question: Which valuations contribute to IE-041-1-4?
evidence_sql: SELECT c.contribution_id,c.valuation_id,c.contribution_amount FROM exposure_contributions c WHERE c.exposure_id='IE-041-1-4' ORDER BY c.valuation_id

question: Reconcile IE-041-1-4 exposure from its two position contributions.
evidence_sql: SELECT e.exposure_id,e.exposure_amount,ROUND(SUM(c.contribution_amount),2) AS contribution_total,e.ratio,e.denominator_amount FROM issuer_exposures e JOIN exposure_contributions c USING(exposure_id) WHERE e.exposure_id='IE-041-1-4' GROUP BY e.exposure_id

question: Trace PF-043’s current issuer breaches to issuer names and thresholds.
evidence_sql: SELECT l.portfolio_id,e.name,a.assessment_id,a.observed_value,l.threshold,a.assessment_status FROM limit_assessments a JOIN mandate_limits l USING(limit_id) JOIN legal_entities e ON l.entity_id=e.entity_id WHERE l.portfolio_id='PF-043' AND a.as_of_date='2027-02-28' AND l.measure='issuer_ratio' AND a.assessment_status='breach' ORDER BY a.assessment_id

question: Does PF-035 have a complete denominator for issuer concentration?
evidence_sql: SELECT exposure_id,exposure_status,denominator_amount,ratio FROM issuer_exposures WHERE portfolio_id='PF-035' AND as_of_date='2027-02-28' ORDER BY exposure_id

question: List all current issuer breaches with the source issuer and excess in ratio points.
evidence_sql: SELECT l.portfolio_id,l.entity_id,a.observed_value,l.threshold,a.excess_value FROM limit_assessments a JOIN mandate_limits l USING(limit_id) WHERE a.as_of_date='2027-02-28' AND l.measure='issuer_ratio' AND a.assessment_status='breach' ORDER BY l.portfolio_id,l.entity_id

question: For every complete portfolio at 2027-02-28, report issuer count and the sum of all issuer shares; do they sum to one?
evidence_sql: SELECT portfolio_id,ROUND(SUM(ratio),6) AS sum_ratio,COUNT(*) AS issuers FROM issuer_exposures WHERE as_of_date='2027-02-28' AND exposure_status='complete' GROUP BY portfolio_id ORDER BY portfolio_id

question: For current PF-041 issuer breaches, trace contributing valuations to opening balances, related current-month trades and settlement outcomes; do not attribute the whole stock exposure to those trades.
evidence_sql: SELECT a.assessment_id,e.exposure_id,e.issuer_id,c.valuation_id,p.position_id,op.instrument_id,op.quantity AS opening_quantity,p.trade_basis_quantity,t.trade_id,z.side,t.trade_quantity,si.instruction_id,si.due_date,se.event_status,se.settled_quantity,si.required_quantity-se.settled_quantity AS remaining_quantity,se.failure_reason FROM limit_assessments a JOIN issuer_exposures e ON a.issuer_exposure_id=e.exposure_id JOIN exposure_contributions c USING(exposure_id) JOIN valuation_snapshots v USING(valuation_id) JOIN positions p USING(position_id) JOIN opening_positions op USING(opening_id) JOIN trade_orders z ON z.account_id=op.account_id AND z.instrument_id=op.instrument_id JOIN securities_transactions t USING(order_id) JOIN settlement_instructions si USING(trade_id) JOIN settlement_state se USING(instruction_id) WHERE e.portfolio_id='PF-041' AND a.as_of_date='2027-02-28' AND a.assessment_status='breach' AND t.trade_date BETWEEN '2027-02-01' AND '2027-02-28' ORDER BY a.assessment_id,op.instrument_id,t.trade_id

question: What is CE-046-4’s unsettled USD receivable?
evidence_sql: SELECT exposure_id,unsettled_receivable,currency,as_of_date FROM counterparty_exposures WHERE exposure_id='CE-046-4'

question: What is the receivable threshold for PF-046?
evidence_sql: SELECT limit_id,threshold,currency,measure FROM mandate_limits WHERE limit_id='LIM-046-C'

question: Which counterparty is recorded on CE-047-4?
evidence_sql: SELECT c.exposure_id,c.counterparty_id,e.name AS counterparty_name FROM counterparty_exposures c JOIN legal_entities e ON e.entity_id=c.counterparty_id WHERE c.exposure_id='CE-047-4'

question: Compare PF-001’s settled receivable with PF-019’s pending receivable.
evidence_sql: SELECT portfolio_id,unsettled_receivable,currency FROM counterparty_exposures WHERE portfolio_id IN ('PF-001','PF-019') AND as_of_date='2027-02-28' ORDER BY portfolio_id

question: Which February sell trades create PF-046’s receivable?
evidence_sql: SELECT t.trade_id,o.side,i.currency,t.trade_quantity-e.settled_quantity AS open_quantity,t.execution_price,i.price_multiplier,e.failure_reason FROM securities_transactions t JOIN trade_orders o USING(order_id) JOIN accounts a USING(account_id) JOIN financial_instruments i USING(instrument_id) JOIN settlement_instructions s USING(trade_id) JOIN settlement_state e USING(instruction_id) WHERE a.portfolio_id='PF-046' AND t.trade_date BETWEEN '2027-02-01' AND '2027-02-28' AND o.side='sell' ORDER BY t.trade_id

question: What assessment and excess amount explain PF-048’s current counterparty breach?
evidence_sql: SELECT a.assessment_id,a.counterparty_exposure_id,a.observed_value,l.threshold,a.excess_value,a.assessment_status FROM limit_assessments a JOIN mandate_limits l USING(limit_id) WHERE l.portfolio_id='PF-048' AND l.measure='receivable_amount' AND a.as_of_date='2027-02-28'

question: Are PF-029 and PF-046 both settlement failures but different limit outcomes?
evidence_sql: SELECT l.portfolio_id,a.observed_value,l.threshold,a.assessment_status FROM limit_assessments a JOIN mandate_limits l USING(limit_id) WHERE l.portfolio_id IN ('PF-029','PF-046') AND l.measure='receivable_amount' AND a.as_of_date='2027-02-28' ORDER BY l.portfolio_id

question: Trace PF-046’s current receivable breach to each open sell instruction, cumulative settlement state and USD contribution; reconcile the total against the assessed limit.
evidence_sql: SELECT a.portfolio_id,c.counterparty_id,la.assessment_id,la.assessment_status,l.threshold,t.trade_id,s.instruction_id,s.due_date,e.event_status,e.failure_reason,t.trade_quantity,e.settled_quantity,t.trade_quantity-e.settled_quantity AS open_quantity,DROUND(DMUL(DSUB(t.trade_quantity,e.settled_quantity),t.execution_price,i.price_multiplier,f.rate),2) AS trade_contribution,ROUND(SUM((t.trade_quantity-e.settled_quantity)*t.execution_price*i.price_multiplier*f.rate) OVER (),2) AS reconstructed_receivable,c.unsettled_receivable FROM securities_transactions t JOIN trade_orders o USING(order_id) JOIN accounts a USING(account_id) JOIN financial_instruments i USING(instrument_id) JOIN settlement_instructions s USING(trade_id) JOIN settlement_state e USING(instruction_id) JOIN fx_rates f ON f.from_currency=i.currency AND f.as_of_date='2027-02-28' JOIN counterparty_exposures c ON c.portfolio_id=a.portfolio_id AND c.as_of_date='2027-02-28' JOIN limit_assessments la ON la.counterparty_exposure_id=c.exposure_id JOIN mandate_limits l USING(limit_id) WHERE a.portfolio_id='PF-046' AND t.trade_date<='2027-02-28' AND o.side='sell' AND t.trade_quantity>e.settled_quantity ORDER BY t.trade_id

question: Which current counterparty receivable limits breach, and what is total excess USD?
evidence_sql: SELECT l.portfolio_id,l.limit_id,a.assessment_id,a.observed_value,l.threshold,a.excess_value,COUNT(*) OVER () AS breached_limits,ROUND(SUM(a.excess_value) OVER (),2) AS excess_usd FROM limit_assessments a JOIN mandate_limits l USING(limit_id) WHERE a.as_of_date='2027-02-28' AND l.measure='receivable_amount' AND a.assessment_status='breach' ORDER BY l.portfolio_id,l.limit_id

question: Compare all seven business branches by current receivable and breached receivable limits.
evidence_sql: SELECT p.branch,COUNT(*) AS portfolios,ROUND(SUM(c.unsettled_receivable),2) AS usd_receivable,SUM(CASE WHEN a.assessment_status='breach' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS breached_limits FROM portfolios p JOIN counterparty_exposures c USING(portfolio_id) JOIN limit_assessments a ON a.counterparty_exposure_id=c.exposure_id WHERE c.as_of_date='2027-02-28' GROUP BY p.branch ORDER BY p.branch

question: Which issuer limits apply to PF-049’s March planning snapshot?

question: Compare PF-050’s February actual and March planned issuer assessments.

question: Were all future mandate changes known by the February as-of date?
evidence_sql: SELECT limit_id,decision_date,effective_from_date FROM mandate_limits WHERE limit_id LIKE '%-NEXT' ORDER BY limit_id

question: Audit whether any actual position, price, FX or trade is dated after 2027-02-28.
evidence_sql: SELECT 'positions' AS source,COUNT(*) AS future_actual_rows FROM positions WHERE view_kind='actual' AND as_of_date>'2027-02-28' UNION ALL SELECT 'prices',COUNT(*) FROM market_prices WHERE view_kind='actual' AND price_date>'2027-02-28' UNION ALL SELECT 'fx',COUNT(*) FROM fx_rates WHERE view_kind='actual' AND as_of_date>'2027-02-28' UNION ALL SELECT 'trades',COUNT(*) FROM securities_transactions WHERE trade_status='executed' AND trade_date>'2027-02-28'

question: For all portfolios in the future_limit business branch, compare current and March planned issuer assessment counts by status.
evidence_sql: SELECT a.as_of_date,a.view_kind,a.assessment_status,COUNT(*) AS assessments FROM limit_assessments a JOIN mandate_limits l USING(limit_id) JOIN portfolios p USING(portfolio_id) WHERE p.branch='future_limit' AND l.measure='issuer_ratio' AND a.as_of_date IN ('2027-02-28','2027-03-31') GROUP BY a.as_of_date,a.view_kind,a.assessment_status ORDER BY a.as_of_date,a.assessment_status

question: Check every assessment uses a known approved limit valid on its own date; report breaches of this rule by view.
evidence_sql: SELECT a.view_kind,COUNT(*) AS assessments,SUM(CASE WHEN a.as_of_date<l.effective_from_date OR a.as_of_date>l.effective_to_date OR l.decision_date>a.known_date OR l.approval<>'approved' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS invalid_limit_uses FROM limit_assessments a JOIN mandate_limits l USING(limit_id) GROUP BY a.view_kind ORDER BY a.view_kind
